output_list.criticism: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When the mintedAmount is large, the balanceOf[target] += mintedAmount; totalSupply += mintedAmount; can cause a overflow, and the minted tokens will be lost forever.
The transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When the _value is large, the balanceOf[msg.sender] -= _value; can cause a overflow, and the attackers' balance will be lost.
The transferFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When the _value is large, the balanceOf[_from] -= _value; can cause a overflow, and the attackers' balance will be lost.
The buy function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When the msg.value is large, the amount = msg.value / buyPrice; can cause a overflow, and the attackers' balance will be lost.

The sell function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When the amount is large, the if (!msg.sender.send(amount * sellPrice)) { throw; } can cause a overflow, and the attackers' balance will be lost.
